title: epan/dissectors/packet-ieee1722.c: Fixed the ieee1722 fdf_rvals table ranges
description:
I noticed while debugging AVTP traffic that the IEEE 1722 dissector had the wrong ranges set in the "fdf_rvals" table. The original values assumed that the values for that field included an additional 3 bits at the end that were assumed to be masked to 0, but in reality the values did not include these 3 bits, so the ranges in this table should be smaller and lower.

This bug was causing the stream format to always show as "AM824".

Source for the information relating to this can be found in IEC standard 61883-6 Table 16 "Subformat and FDF allocations".

![Screenshot 2024-08-13 at 2.39.10 PM.png](/uploads/36df36491af28b6889c5268a498c3297/Screenshot_2024-08-13_at_2.39.10_PM.png)

Original (incorrect) value:

![Screenshot 2024-08-13 at 2.36.56 PM.png](/uploads/860c3e09f078cbddd466fe0b00046a6b/Screenshot_2024-08-13_at_2.36.56_PM.png){width=1751 height=423}Fixed value:

![Screenshot 2024-08-13 at 2.54.00 PM.png](/uploads/c640bda88609e561aa2389cb5711fc55/Screenshot_2024-08-13_at_2.54.00_PM.png){width=566 height=287}

changes_data.diff:
@@ -396,15 +396,15 @@ static const value_string fraction_number_vals [] = {
 };
 
 static const range_string fdf_rvals [] = {
-    {0x00, 0x07,    "Basic format for AM824"},
-    {0x08, 0x0f,    "Basic format for AM824. Transmission rate may be controlled by an AV/C command set"},
-    {0x10, 0x17,    "Basic format for 24-bit*4 audio pack"},
-    {0x18, 0x1f,    "Reserved"},
-    {0x20, 0x27,    "Basic format for 32-bit floating-point data"},
-    {0x28, 0x2f,    "Reserved"},
-    {0x30, 0x37,    "Basic format for 32-bit generic data"},
-    {0x38, 0x3f,    "Reserved"},
-    {0x40, 0xfe,    "Reserved"},
+    {0x00, 0x00,    "Basic format for AM824"},
+    {0x01, 0x01,    "Basic format for AM824. Transmission rate may be controlled by an AV/C command set"},
+    {0x02, 0x02,    "Basic format for 24-bit*4 audio pack"},
+    {0x03, 0x03,    "Reserved"},
+    {0x04, 0x04,    "Basic format for 32-bit floating-point data"},
+    {0x05, 0x05,    "Reserved"},
+    {0x06, 0x06,    "Basic format for 32-bit generic data"},
+    {0x07, 0x07,    "Reserved"},
+    {0x08, 0xfe,    "Reserved"},
     {0xff, 0xff,    "Packet for NO-DATA"},
     {0,    0,       NULL}
 };
